'''''Mission from Mount Yoda''''' ([[1993]]) is the fourth book of the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince]] series by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]]. It is set in the [[New Republic era]] and written for an audience of young readers.
